organization: City of Chicago, Department of Public Health (Chicago Data Portal)
title: Food Inspections (Socrata API) - Stage E analyst queries, 2024-11-26..2026-11-25 (35,722 inspection records)
claim: 12 months to 2026-11-25: 10,140 licences inspected; 2,008 cited under violation 38; 942 with pest-activity evidence in comments (droppings, mice/rats, roaches, flies, live/dead insects; gap-only 'rodent' comments excluded); 137 with pest activity in >=2 inspections; 979 'Out of Business'. SW cluster 60608/09/16/23/32: 1,492 licences, 428 v38, 165 pest-activity (11.1%), 22 repeat; NW 60647/39/18/41/22: 119 of 1,319; Far NW/N 60625/40/59/45/26: 89 of 765. After a failed pest-activity inspection (24-month data) the next inspection came a median 7 days later (59% <=7d, 93% <=14d); 79.5% passed it; 8.5% still showed pests. Pest-activity share of inspections by calendar month: Dec 4.8% (low) to Sep 8.8% (high). Inspector comments quote the rule that retail food establishments must contract with a licensed Illinois exterminator providing service at least twice a year and keep a 12-month logbook with service reports and the company's IDPH licence number (7-38-020(C)).
excerpt: SHALL CONTRACT WITH A LICENSED ILLINOIS EXTERMINATOR WHO SHALL PROVIDE INSECT AND VERMIN SERVICES AT THE ESTABLISHMENT AT LEAST TWICE A YEAR.
limitations: Counts depend on analyst regex classification of free text (stricter than Stage D, so lower: 942 vs 1,416); licences are not unique businesses; ~2-5 day posting lag; the Municipal Code/Food Code Rules text itself was not retrievable (chicago.gov PDFs 403; amlegal 403), so the twice-a-year rule is as quoted by inspectors.

title: Pest Control Exam Calendar (data table), fetched 2026-11-28
claim: Remaining 2026 sessions: 12/16/2026 at IDPH Westchester Region Office (3 Westbrook Corporate Center), 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM, 10 seats each, status OPEN. No 2027 dates posted as of 2026-11-28. Westchester sessions run roughly monthly (7/8, 8/12, 9/16, 10/14, 11/18, 12/16).
excerpt: 12/16/2026 OPEN 10 9:00 AM IDPH Westchester Region Office
limitations: Seat status may change daily; 2027 schedule unknown; combined with the 15-day receipt rule, the 12/16 sitting requires the application to arrive by 12/1/2026.

title: Structural Pest Control program page and FAQ (licensing steps, renewals, study materials)
claim: Steps: pass exam(s) or employ a CT, then mail the Commercial Business License Application with documents and fee; insurer submits the Certificate of Insurance form. FAQ: business licences expire December 31 each year; renewal notice mailed at least 30 days before the December 1 due date. Study materials (General Standards Manual, practice exam, pest fact sheets, Act and Code) are free online. ~750 licensed business locations, ~2,600 certified individuals.
excerpt: Business licenses expire December 31 of every year.
limitations: Processing time for the business licence is not stated (MISSING). Public business-verification lookup is behind a JavaScript WAF (403) and was not used.

title: Structural Pest Control Certification Application - General Use (PCO form Rev. 9/17)
claim: Mail-in only: $75 by personal check, cashier's check or money order; must be RECEIVED by IDPH no later than 15 days before the first chosen exam date; list three date/location preferences (next available used if first is full); 2x2 colour photo on photographic paper; high-school/GED details; written cancellation >=2 business days before the exam or a new application and fee are required.
excerpt: the completed application and fee must be received by IDPH no later than 15 days prior to the chosen examination date.
limitations: Form dated 2017; still the form linked from the IDPH page on 2026-11-28; fee could have changed without a new form (confirm).
